title: Will Mike Vrabel Be Fired? Polymarket Sets 2026 Exit Odds for Patriots HC

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will Mike Vrabel Be Fired? Polymarket Sets 2026 Exit Odds for Patriots HC
sources.description: Will Mike Vrabel still be leading the New England Patriots by the end of 2026? A new Polymarket market is tracking the odds of Vrabel being fired as Patriots head coach before Dec. 31, 2026.
